Lebensraum.evidence_anchor: Deadwood is known to be an important structural component of forests (Bauhus et al., 2009) that influences a large number of ecosystem functions (Harmon et al., 1986; Cornwell et al., 2009) and is a critical resource for wood-dwelling organisms (Lonsdale et al., 2008; Rondeux and Sanchez, 2010; Stokland et al., 2012).
